BiblicalUsage: In the days of the rebuilding the prophets prophesy to the Jews, and Zerubbabel and Jeshua rise up with the prophets of God helping them.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the prophets do not only speak: they help, standing beside the builders until the house rises, and the word of God is a working word.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
